title: POSI Annual Journal Metric Snapshot
description: One frozen record per journal per metric_year. Never mutated after a PJR release is tagged — corrections produce a new snapshot with a note, not a silent edit.

pci.description: 2-year POSI Citation Impact: citations in metric_year to citable items published in (metric_year-1, metric_year-2), divided by the count of those citable items.

pnci.description: POSI Normalized Citation Indicator: this journal's citation rate divided by the expected citation rate for its primary PSC category and metric_year. 1.00 = category average.

pcs.description: POSI Citation Score: Crossref-based 4-year citation-performance indicator (PCS-1.0-SPEC.md). Independently reported — does not determine PCI, PNCI, Citation Rank, Citation Percentile, or Citation Quartile, and is never averaged or blended with the PCI family.

pcs_window_start_year.description: First of the 4 complete publication years in this PCS snapshot's window (PCS-1.0-SPEC.md § 5) — e.g. 2022 for a 2026 release covering 2022-2025.

pcs_window_end_year.description: Last of the 4 complete publication years in this PCS snapshot's window — e.g. 2025 for a 2026 release covering 2022-2025.

pcs_eligible_items.description: PCS denominator: count of eligible works successfully fetched from Crossref across the 4-year window (PCS-1.0-SPEC.md § 5), no sampling cap.

pcs_items_with_citation_data.description: Of pcs_eligible_items, how many had Crossref actually return an is_referenced_by_count field (including an explicit 0) — distinct from an eligible item whose field was entirely absent and was defaulted to 0 (PCS-1.0-SPEC.md § 7, src/pcs.mjs's calculatePcs()). Lets a reader distinguish '111 of 120 eligible items had real Crossref citation data' from '120 eligible items went into the PCS average.'

pcs_coverage.description: Fraction of enumerated in-window DOIs successfully fetched from Crossref for this PCS snapshot, independent of document-type filtering (PCS-1.0-SPEC.md § 9, calculatePcsCoverage()). Separate from the platform's general Evidence Coverage model, which governs AJR-E/AJR-M rating eligibility, not citation-indicator display.

pcs_source.description: Always 'crossref' once populated — explicit so a reader never has to assume which citation graph a pcs value came from, unlike pci/pci_5yr/pnci which are OpenAlex-sourced.

pcs_source_retrieved_at.description: Date the Crossref fetch for this PCS snapshot was run. Distinct from snapshot_date (when the overall metric snapshot was frozen) and data_cutoff (the general citation-data cutoff), since PCS's Crossref fetch and PCI's OpenAlex fetch can happen on different days.

pcs_methodology_version.description: e.g. PCS-1.0. Independent of methodology_version (PCI's version string), per PJR-SPEC.md § 11's independent-version-strings rule.

citable_items.description: Denominator: count of documents of an eligible document_type (see PJR-SPEC.md § Citable Items) published in the PCI window.

citation_count.description: Numerator: citations in metric_year to those citable items, excluding citations to/from retracted content (see PJR-SPEC.md § Retractions).

total_citations.description: All-time citations to this journal's output, independent of the PCI window.

international.description: Reported separately from PCI — never folded into the citation-impact score (see PJR-SPEC.md § International Reach).

status.description: suppressed = citation pattern under integrity review, see PJR-SPEC.md § Citation Integrity. insufficient_data = journal is metric_eligible but this year's window has too little history.

pjr_release.description: e.g. PJR-2028.1 — the release this snapshot was frozen for, once published.
